choices.text: there is sufficient evidence that the mean strength is above the standard

choices.label: B
choices.text: the mean strength is proven exactly equal to the standard

choices.label: C
choices.text: there is sufficient evidence that the mean strength is below the standard

choices.label: D
choices.text: the data cannot be tested because sigma is known

common_mistakes: Rejecting H0 when the p-value is larger than alpha.
Saying that H0 is proven true after failing to reject it.
hints: Reject H0 only when the p-value is at most alpha.
Failing to reject H0 means insufficient evidence, not proof that H0 is true.
